description: Datasets for quantifying hydropower flexibility during extreme temperature events submitted to the JAWRA Journal. is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Kyongho Son, Cameron Bracken (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). This project used the observed hydropower data to quantifiy the hydropower flexiablity of Big-10 Reserviors in the Columbia River Basin. ## Key data sets county level temperature daily hydropower production data hydropower plant's capacity estimated hydropower flexiablity cold snap/heat wave events. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
